# Terrestrial LiDAR

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# chunk options
knitr::opts_chunk$set(eval = FALSE, echo = TRUE, width = 300, warning = FALSE, out.width = "45%", fig.show = 'hold', fig.align = "center")

# libraries needed
libs <- c("tinytex", "ggplot2", "dplyr", "tidyr", "rlang", "usethis", "bookdown", "knitr", "rmarkdown", "spelling", "lidR", "shapefiles", "sf", "terra", "raster", "ggplot2", "easypackages", "spatialEco", "rasterVis")

# install missing libraries
installed_libs <- libs %in% rownames(installed.packages())
if (any(installed_libs == F)) {
  install.packages(libs[!installed_libs])
}

# load libraries
lapply(libs, library, character.only = T)
```

## Classifing LiDAR point clouds

Technical resources

-   sf manual: <https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/sf/sf.pdf>

-   lidR manual: <https://r-lidar.github.io/lidRbook/>

-   shapefiles manual: <https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/shapefiles/shapefiles.pdf>

-   MNtopo <https://files.dnr.state.mn.us/aboutdnr/gis/mntopo/mntopo_help_document.pdf>

-   EPSG info: <https://www.nceas.ucsb.edu/sites/default/files/2020-04/OverviewCoordinateReferenceSystems.pdf>

-   SF: https://r-spatial.github.io/sf/articles/sf1.html#reading-and-writing

```{r}
# install.packages('lidRviewer', repos = 'https://r-lidar.r-universe.dev')

library(lidRviewer)

# testing
las <- readLAS("C:/Users/natha/Documents/local_data/_data/_terrestrial_lidar/_processed_scans/2025-03-27_TLS_MAG_NL/Arb_Mar25_1_all_wgs84utm15N_classified-002.laz")


summary(las)

plot(las, color = "Classification", size = 3, bg = "white") 

# set coordinate system
st_crs(las) <- 26915

las_check(las)



# Plot las object by scan angle, 
# make the background white, 
# display XYZ axis and  scale colors
plot(las, color = "RGB", bg = "white", axis = TRUE, legend = TRUE)

```
